
            <h1 class="postTitle">
                <a id="cb_post_title_url" class="postTitle2 vertical-middle" href="https://www.cnblogs.com/jixingsuiyuan/p/19114022" title="发布于 2025-09-26 18:19">
    <span role="heading" aria-level="2">【RabbitMQ】主题（Topics）与主题交换机（Topic Exchange）</span>
    

</a>

            </h1>
            <div class="clear"></div>
            <div class="postBody">
                <div id="cnblogs_post_body" class="blogpost-body blogpost-body-html">
<h2>本章目标</h2>
<ul>
<li>
<p class="ds-markdown-paragraph">理解主题交换机（Topic Exchange）的强大路由能力。</p>
</li>
<li>
<p class="ds-markdown-paragraph">掌握通配符<code>*</code>和<code>#</code>的使用规则。</p>
</li>
<li>
<p class="ds-markdown-paragraph">学习基于模式匹配的复杂消息路由。</p>
</li>
<li>
<p class="ds-markdown-paragraph">实现一个支持多维度过滤的智能消息系统。</p>
</li>
</ul>
<hr>
<h2>一、理论部分</h2>
<h3>1. 主题交换机（Topic Exchange）简介</h3>
<p class="ds-markdown-paragraph">主题交换机是RabbitMQ中最灵活也是最强大的交换机类型。它结合了扇形交换机的广播能力和直连交换机的精确匹配能力，同时引入了模式匹配的概念。</p>
<p class="ds-markdown-paragraph">主题交换机的工作方式：</p>
<ul>
<li>
<p class="ds-markdown-paragraph">消息仍然带有路由键（Routing Key），但路由键必须是由点号分隔的单词列表（如：<code>usa.news</code>、<code>europe.weather.alert</code>）。</p>
</li>
<li>
<p class="ds-markdown-paragraph">队列通过绑定键（Binding Key）&nbsp;绑定到交换机，绑定键也使用相同的点号分隔格式。</p>
</li>
<li>
<p class="ds-markdown-paragraph">绑定键支持两种通配符进行模式匹配。</p>
</li>
</ul>
<h3>2. 通配符规则</h3>
<p class="ds-markdown-paragraph">主题交换机的强大之处在于绑定键支持通配符：</p>
<ul>
<li>
<p class="ds-markdown-paragraph"><code>*</code>（星号）：匹配恰好一个单词</p>
<ul>
<li>
<p class="ds-markdown-paragraph">示例：<code>*.orange.*</code>&nbsp;可以匹配&nbsp;<code>quick.orange.rabbit</code>，但不能匹配&nbsp;<code>quick.orange.fox.jumps</code></p>
</li>
</ul>
</li>
<li>
<p class="ds-markdown-paragraph"><code>#</code>（井号）：匹配零个或多个单词</p>
<ul>
<li>
<p class="ds-markdown-paragraph">示例：<code>lazy.#</code>&nbsp;可以匹配&nbsp;<code>lazy</code>、<code>lazy.fox</code>、<code>lazy.brown.fox</code>、<code>lazy.pink.fox.jumps.over</code></p>
</li>
</ul>
</li>
</ul>
<h3>3. 路由键格式最佳实践</h3>
<p class="ds-markdown-paragraph">路由键通常采用层次结构，便于模式匹配：</p>
<ul>
<li>
<p class="ds-markdown-paragraph"><code>&lt;facility&gt;.&lt;severity&gt;</code>：<code>auth.info</code>、<code>kernel.error</code></p>
</li>
<li>
<p class="ds-markdown-paragraph"><code>&lt;region&gt;.&lt;service&gt;.&lt;event&gt;</code>：<code>usa.payment.success</code>、<code>europe.order.cancelled</code></p>
</li>
<li>
<p class="ds-markdown-paragraph"><code>&lt;category&gt;.&lt;subcategory&gt;.&lt;action&gt;</code>：<code>news.sports.update</code>、<code>weather.alert.severe</code></p>
</li>
</ul>
<h3>4. 使用场景</h3>
<p class="ds-markdown-paragraph">主题交换机适用于需要复杂、灵活的消息路由场景：</p>
<ul>
<li>
<p class="ds-markdown-paragraph">新闻订阅系统：用户可以根据兴趣订阅特定主题（如<code>sports.*</code>、<code>*.finance</code>）</p>
</li>
<li>
<p class="ds-markdown-paragraph">物联网设备监控：按设备类型、地理位置、告警级别路由消息</p>
</li>
<li>
<p class="ds-markdown-paragraph">微服务事件总线：基于事件类型和来源进行精细路由</p>
</li>
</ul>
<hr>
<h2>二、实操部分：构建智能新闻分发系统</h2>
<p class="ds-markdown-paragraph">我们将构建一个新闻分发系统，其中：</p>
<ul>
<li>
<p class="ds-markdown-paragraph">生产者发送带有分类路由键的新闻消息</p>
</li>
<li>
<p class="ds-markdown-paragraph">消费者可以根据兴趣订阅特定模式的新闻</p>
</li>
</ul>
<h3>第1步：创建项目</h3>
<ol start="1">
<li>
<p class="ds-markdown-paragraph">创建一个新的解决方案。</p>
</li>
<li>
<p class="ds-markdown-paragraph">添加一个控制台应用程序项目作为生产者：<code>EmitLogTopic</code>。</p>
</li>
<li>
<p class="ds-markdown-paragraph">添加多个消费者项目：</p>
<ul>
<li>
<p class="ds-markdown-paragraph"><code>ReceiveNewsAll</code>&nbsp;- 接收所有新闻</p>
</li>
<li>
<p class="ds-markdown-paragraph"><code>ReceiveSportsNews</code>&nbsp;- 接收所有体育新闻</p>
</li>
<li>
<p class="ds-markdown-paragraph"><code>ReceiveUSNews</code>&nbsp;- 接收所有美国新闻</p>
</li>
<li>
<p class="ds-markdown-paragraph"><code>ReceiveCriticalAlerts</code>&nbsp;- 接收所有紧急警报</p>
</li>
<li>
<p class="ds-markdown-paragraph"><code>ReceiveWeatherUpdates</code>&nbsp;- 接收所有天气更新</p>
</li>
</ul>
</li>
<li>
<p class="ds-markdown-paragraph">为所有项目添加<code>RabbitMQ.Client</code>&nbsp;NuGet包。</p>
</li>
</ol>
<h3>第2步：编写新闻生产者（EmitLogTopic.cs）</h3>

<div class="md-code-block-banner-wrap">
<div class="md-code-block-banner md-code-block-banner-lite">

<pre><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">using</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> System.Text;
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">using</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> RabbitMQ.Client;

</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">var</span> factory = <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">new</span> ConnectionFactory() { HostName = <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">localhost</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>, UserName = <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">myuser</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>, Password = <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">mypassword</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> };

</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">using</span> (<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">var</span> connection =<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> factory.CreateConnection())
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">using</span> (<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">var</span> channel =<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> connection.CreateModel())
{
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 声明主题交换机</span>
    channel.ExchangeDeclare(exchange: <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">topic_logs</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">, type: ExchangeType.Topic);

    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 路由键格式：&lt;category&gt;.&lt;region&gt;.&lt;severity&gt;
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 示例：news.usa.info, sports.europe.alert, weather.asia.critical</span>
    <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">var</span> routingKey = (args.Length &gt; <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">0</span>) ? args[<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">0</span>] : <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">anonymous.info</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">;
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">var</span> message = (args.Length &gt; <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">1</span>) ? <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">string</span>.Join(<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>, args.Skip(<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">1</span>).ToArray()) : <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">Hello World!</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">;
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">var</span> body =<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> Encoding.UTF8.GetBytes(message);

    channel.BasicPublish(exchange: </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">topic_logs</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">,
                         routingKey: routingKey,
                         basicProperties: </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">null</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">,
                         body: body);

    Console.WriteLine($</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)"> [x] Sent '{routingKey}':'{message}'</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">);
}

Console.WriteLine(</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)"> Press [enter] to exit.</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">);
Console.ReadLine();</span></pre>
</div>
</div>
</div>

<h3>第3步：编写接收所有新闻的消费者（ReceiveNewsAll.cs）</h3>
<div class="md-code-block md-code-block-light">
<div class="md-code-block-banner-wrap">
<div class="md-code-block-banner md-code-block-banner-lite">

<div class="d2a24f03">
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">using</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> System.Text;
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">using</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> RabbitMQ.Client;
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">using</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> RabbitMQ.Client.Events;

</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">var</span> factory = <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">new</span> ConnectionFactory() { HostName = <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">localhost</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>, UserName = <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">myuser</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>, Password = <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">mypassword</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> };

</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">using</span> (<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">var</span> connection =<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> factory.CreateConnection())
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">using</span> (<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">var</span> channel =<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> connection.CreateModel())
{
    channel.ExchangeDeclare(exchange: </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">topic_logs</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">, type: ExchangeType.Topic);
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">var</span> queueName =<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> channel.QueueDeclare().QueueName;

    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 使用 # 匹配所有消息</span>
    channel.QueueBind(queue: queueName, exchange: <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">topic_logs</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>, routingKey: <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">#</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">);

    Console.WriteLine($</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)"> [*] Waiting for ALL news. Queue: {queueName}</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">);

    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">var</span> consumer = <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">new</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> EventingBasicConsumer(channel);
    consumer.Received </span>+= (model, ea) =&gt;<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">
    {
        </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">var</span> body =<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> ea.Body.ToArray();
        </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">var</span> message =<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> Encoding.UTF8.GetString(body);
        Console.WriteLine($</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)"> [x] [ALL] Received '{ea.RoutingKey}':'{message}'</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">);
    };

    channel.BasicConsume(queue: queueName, autoAck: </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">true</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">, consumer: consumer);
    Console.WriteLine(</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)"> Press [enter] to exit.</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">);
    Console.ReadLine();
}</span></pre>

</div>

<pre><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">using</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> System.Text;
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">using</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> RabbitMQ.Client;
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">using</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> RabbitMQ.Client.Events;

</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">var</span> factory = <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">new</span> ConnectionFactory() { HostName = <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">localhost</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>, UserName = <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">myuser</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>, Password = <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">mypassword</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> };

</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">using</span> (<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">var</span> connection =<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> factory.CreateConnection())
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">using</span> (<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">var</span> channel =<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> connection.CreateModel())
{
    channel.ExchangeDeclare(exchange: </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">topic_logs</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">, type: ExchangeType.Topic);
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">var</span> queueName =<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> channel.QueueDeclare().QueueName;

    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 匹配所有体育相关的新闻：sports.*.*</span>
    channel.QueueBind(queue: queueName, exchange: <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">topic_logs</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>, routingKey: <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">sports.#</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">);

    Console.WriteLine($</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)"> [*] Waiting for SPORTS news. Queue: {queueName}</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">);

    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">var</span> consumer = <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">new</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> EventingBasicConsumer(channel);
    consumer.Received </span>+= (model, ea) =&gt;<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">
    {
        </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">var</span> body =<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> ea.Body.ToArray();
        </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">var</span> message =<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> Encoding.UTF8.GetString(body);
        Console.WriteLine($</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)"> [x] [SPORTS] Received '{ea.RoutingKey}':'{message}'</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">);
    };

    channel.BasicConsume(queue: queueName, autoAck: </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">true</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">, consumer: consumer);
    Console.WriteLine(</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)"> Press [enter] to exit.</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">);
    Console.ReadLine();
}</span></pre>

<h3>第5步：编写接收美国新闻的消费者（ReceiveUSNews.cs）</h3>
<div class="md-code-block md-code-block-light">
<div class="md-code-block-banner-wrap">
<div class="md-code-block-banner md-code-block-banner-lite">
<div class="_121d384">
<div class="d2a24f03">
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">using</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> System.Text;
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">using</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> RabbitMQ.Client;
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">using</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> RabbitMQ.Client.Events;

</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">var</span> factory = <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">new</span> ConnectionFactory() { HostName = <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">localhost</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>, UserName = <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">myuser</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>, Password = <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">mypassword</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> };

</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">using</span> (<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">var</span> connection =<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> factory.CreateConnection())
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">using</span> (<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">var</span> channel =<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> connection.CreateModel())
{
    channel.ExchangeDeclare(exchange: </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">topic_logs</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">, type: ExchangeType.Topic);
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">var</span> queueName =<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> channel.QueueDeclare().QueueName;

    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 匹配所有美国相关的新闻：*.usa.*</span>
    channel.QueueBind(queue: queueName, exchange: <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">topic_logs</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>, routingKey: <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">*.usa.*</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">);

    Console.WriteLine($</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)"> [*] Waiting for USA news. Queue: {queueName}</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">);

    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">var</span> consumer = <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">new</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> EventingBasicConsumer(channel);
    consumer.Received </span>+= (model, ea) =&gt;<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">
    {
        </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">var</span> body =<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> ea.Body.ToArray();
        </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">var</span> message =<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> Encoding.UTF8.GetString(body);
        Console.WriteLine($</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)"> [x] [USA] Received '{ea.RoutingKey}':'{message}'</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">);
    };

    channel.BasicConsume(queue: queueName, autoAck: </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">true</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">, consumer: consumer);
    Console.WriteLine(</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)"> Press [enter] to exit.</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">);
    Console.ReadLine();
}</span></pre>
</div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
</div>

<h3>第6步：编写接收紧急警报的消费者（ReceiveCriticalAlerts.cs）</h3>
<div class="md-code-block md-code-block-light">
<div class="md-code-block-banner-wrap">
<div class="md-code-block-banner md-code-block-banner-lite">
<div class="_121d384">
<div class="d2a24f03">
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">using</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> System.Text;
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">using</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> RabbitMQ.Client;
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">using</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> RabbitMQ.Client.Events;

</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">var</span> factory = <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">new</span> ConnectionFactory() { HostName = <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">localhost</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>, UserName = <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">myuser</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>, Password = <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">mypassword</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> };

</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">using</span> (<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">var</span> connection =<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> factory.CreateConnection())
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">using</span> (<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">var</span> channel =<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> connection.CreateModel())
{
    channel.ExchangeDeclare(exchange: </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">topic_logs</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">, type: ExchangeType.Topic);
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">var</span> queueName =<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> channel.QueueDeclare().QueueName;

    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 匹配所有紧急级别的消息：*.*.critical</span>
    channel.QueueBind(queue: queueName, exchange: <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">topic_logs</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>, routingKey: <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">*.*.critical</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">);

    Console.WriteLine($</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)"> [*] Waiting for CRITICAL alerts. Queue: {queueName}</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">);

    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">var</span> consumer = <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">new</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> EventingBasicConsumer(channel);
    consumer.Received </span>+= (model, ea) =&gt;<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">
    {
        </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">var</span> body =<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> ea.Body.ToArray();
        </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">var</span> message =<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> Encoding.UTF8.GetString(body);
        Console.WriteLine($</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)"> [x] [CRITICAL] Received '{ea.RoutingKey}':'{message}'</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">);
        Console.WriteLine(</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">    -&gt; Sending emergency notification!</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">);
    };

    channel.BasicConsume(queue: queueName, autoAck: </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">true</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">, consumer: consumer);
    Console.WriteLine(</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)"> Press [enter] to exit.</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">);
    Console.ReadLine();
}</span></pre>
</div>
</div>

<h3>第7步：编写接收天气更新的消费者（ReceiveWeatherUpdates.cs）</h3>
<div class="md-code-block md-code-block-light">
<div class="md-code-block-banner-wrap">
<div class="md-code-block-banner md-code-block-banner-lite">
<div class="_121d384">
<div class="d2a24f03">
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">using</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> System.Text;
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">using</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> RabbitMQ.Client;
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">using</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> RabbitMQ.Client.Events;

</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">var</span> factory = <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">new</span> ConnectionFactory() { HostName = <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">localhost</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>, UserName = <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">myuser</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>, Password = <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">mypassword</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> };

</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">using</span> (<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">var</span> connection =<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> factory.CreateConnection())
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">using</span> (<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">var</span> channel =<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> connection.CreateModel())
{
    channel.ExchangeDeclare(exchange: </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">topic_logs</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">, type: ExchangeType.Topic);
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">var</span> queueName =<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> channel.QueueDeclare().QueueName;

    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 匹配所有天气相关的更新：weather.*
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 一个队列可以绑定多个模式</span>
    channel.QueueBind(queue: queueName, exchange: <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">topic_logs</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>, routingKey: <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">weather.#</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">);
    channel.QueueBind(queue: queueName, exchange: </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">topic_logs</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>, routingKey: <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">*.alert</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>); <span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 也接收所有警报</span>
<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">
    Console.WriteLine($</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)"> [*] Waiting for WEATHER updates and ALERTS. Queue: {queueName}</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">);

    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">var</span> consumer = <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">new</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> EventingBasicConsumer(channel);
    consumer.Received </span>+= (model, ea) =&gt;<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">
    {
        </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">var</span> body =<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> ea.Body.ToArray();
        </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">var</span> message =<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> Encoding.UTF8.GetString(body);
        Console.WriteLine($</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)"> [x] [WEATHER/ALERT] Received '{ea.RoutingKey}':'{message}'</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">);
    };

    channel.BasicConsume(queue: queueName, autoAck: </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">true</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">, consumer: consumer);
    Console.WriteLine(</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)"> Press [enter] to exit.</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">);
    Console.ReadLine();
}</span></pre>

<h3>第9步：通配符规则详解示例</h3>
<p class="ds-markdown-paragraph">为了更好理解通配符，让我们看一些匹配示例：</p>
<p class="ds-markdown-paragraph">绑定键&nbsp;<code>*.orange.*</code>&nbsp;的匹配情况：</p>
<ul>
<li>
<p class="ds-markdown-paragraph">✅&nbsp;<code>quick.orange.rabbit</code>&nbsp;(匹配)</p>
</li>
<li>
<p class="ds-markdown-paragraph">✅&nbsp;<code>lazy.orange.elephant</code>&nbsp;(匹配)</p>
</li>
<li>
<p class="ds-markdown-paragraph">❌&nbsp;<code>quick.orange.fox.lazy</code>&nbsp;(不匹配 - 四个单词)</p>
</li>
<li>
<p class="ds-markdown-paragraph">❌&nbsp;<code>orange</code>&nbsp;(不匹配 - 只有一个单词)</p>
</li>
<li>
<p class="ds-markdown-paragraph">❌&nbsp;<code>quick.brown.fox</code>&nbsp;(不匹配 - 中间不是orange)</p>
</li>
</ul>
<p class="ds-markdown-paragraph">绑定键&nbsp;<code>lazy.#</code>&nbsp;的匹配情况：</p>
<ul>
<li>
<p class="ds-markdown-paragraph">✅&nbsp;<code>lazy</code>&nbsp;(匹配)</p>
</li>
<li>
<p class="ds-markdown-paragraph">✅&nbsp;<code>lazy.fox</code>&nbsp;(匹配)</p>
</li>
<li>
<p class="ds-markdown-paragraph">✅&nbsp;<code>lazy.brown.fox</code>&nbsp;(匹配)</p>
</li>
<li>
<p class="ds-markdown-paragraph">✅&nbsp;<code>lazy.pink.fox.jumps.over</code>&nbsp;(匹配)</p>
</li>
<li>
<p class="ds-markdown-paragraph">❌&nbsp;<code>quick.lazy.fox</code>&nbsp;(不匹配 - 第一个单词不是lazy)</p>
</li>
</ul>
<hr>
<h2>本章总结</h2>
<p class="ds-markdown-paragraph">在这一章中，我们深入学习了RabbitMQ中最强大的主题交换机，掌握了基于模式匹配的复杂消息路由：</p>
<ol start="1">
<li>
<p class="ds-markdown-paragraph">主题交换机（Topic Exchange）：理解了基于通配符的模式匹配路由机制。</p>
</li>
<li>
<p class="ds-markdown-paragraph">通配符规则：掌握了<code>*</code>（匹配一个单词）和<code>#</code>（匹配零个或多个单词）的使用方法。</p>
</li>
<li>
<p class="ds-markdown-paragraph">路由键设计：学习了使用点号分隔的层次化路由键设计最佳实践。</p>
</li>
<li>
<p class="ds-markdown-paragraph">复杂路由场景：实现了支持多维度过滤的智能新闻分发系统。</p>
</li>
<li>
<p class="ds-markdown-paragraph">多重模式绑定：掌握了单个队列绑定多个模式的高级用法。</p>
</li>
</ol>
<p class="ds-markdown-paragraph">主题交换机提供了无与伦比的灵活性，是构建复杂事件驱动系统的理想选择。在下一章，我们将转向另一个重要主题：消息可靠性保障，学习如何确保消息在复杂的分布式环境中绝不丢失。</p>
</div>
<div class="clear"></div>
